question: In May 2025, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) approved the renaming of the North East Small Finance Bank to ___________.

options.text: North East Regional Finance Bank Limited

solution:
The correct answer is __**Slice Small Finance Bank Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **May 2025**, the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** gave its formal approval for the rebranding and renaming of **North East Small Finance Bank (NESFB)** to **Slice Small Finance Bank Limited**.
 
• This renaming marks the culmination of the strategic **merger** between the **fintech unicorn** **GaragePreneurs Internet Private Limited (Slice)** and **North East Small Finance Bank**, which was first initiated in **late 2023**.
 
• The transition allows the entity to function as a unified banking platform, combining **Slice’s** digital expertise with **NESFB's** established banking infrastructure in the **North-Eastern states** of **India**.
 
• The **RBI** approval is a critical step in the **fintech-to-bank** transition, ensuring that the new entity complies with all regulatory norms under the **Banking Regulation Act, 1949**.
 
• The headquarters for the new entity remains strategically focused on **Guwahati**, Assam</str
